canonical_project: Uttar Pradesh planned data center cluster - Lucknow
owner: Multiple prospective investors (Hiranandani/Yotta, NTT, Adani, ST Telemedia, Sify, Web Werks et al.) / Government of Uttar Pradesh
notes: ETDatacenters (Jun 23, 2026) reports UP has approved nearly Rs 21,343 crore of data center investment proposals to be distributed across Noida, Yamuna Expressway Region, Lucknow, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Meerut and Sitapur, with 644 MW committed capacity and a 2 GW-by-2030 state target. Lucknow is named among the locations but no specific Lucknow site/developer capacity is allocated in the report.
